d:
The song celebrates the bravery, resilience, and pride of Sikh warriors. It emphasizes values like self-respect, fearlessness, and loyalty to righteousness. The lyrics honour historical Sikh heroes and their unwavering spirit in battle, portraying them as unstoppable forces who never back down or show mercy to enemies.
